firstPlayerRule: The player who has accomplished the most heroic feat starts and takes the Headquarters counter.
clarifications: The rules leave the heroic feat to the players’ judgment.
Each round, every player takes one turn clockwise, starting with the Headquarters counter holder.

sources.title: A Battle through History — English rulebook
